text: The task's due_to is (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Mental disorder" "disorder")). 'Mental disorder' is not a common symptom or warning sign, and a mental illness is more likely to be recorded as a diagnosis/active condition than as a clinical finding, so the task may never fire for the patients the page is about. The house standard accepts a natural clinical_finding as a fallback trigger but expects the gap to be noted; an additional anchor (e.g. a possible diagnosis produced by the mental-health symptom pages, or a warning sign such as Aggressive behavior) would make it live.
